schemes.name: Uttarakhand State Millet Policy — cultivation, procurement and value chain
schemes.support: Production incentive; procurement and project support
schemes.benefit: Policy phases 2025-26–2027-28 and 2028-29–2030-31 cover selected blocks. Sowing incentive per hectare for years 1/2/3 is ₹4,000/₹3,000/₹1,500 for full sowing and ₹2,000/₹1,500/₹750 for other prescribed methods; individual full-rate area 1 ha and group 5 ha, additional area at 50% of applicable table. Group procurement incentive ₹300/quintal for first 15 quintals and ₹150 thereafter. Also includes seed, mechanisation, storage, processing and marketing components.
schemes.eligible: Eligible cultivators, consenting leased cultivators and eligible SHGs/NGOs/FPOs in selected blocks; crop and component conditions apply.
schemes.access: Cultivation application Appendix IV through agriculture portal annually 1 January–15 April during valid phase; contact block agriculture office. Field inspection within 15 days of germination verifies area/method; payment follows approval and budget availability. Procurement/processing require their own approved route.
schemes.caution: Existence is verified; as-of 2 October the stated annual cultivation window is outside intake. Policy ends old Millet Mission 2023-27 upon implementation; pending old dues use old norms and same-benefit duplication is barred.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
schemes.support: Aquaculture, infrastructure, insurance and processing assistance
schemes.benefit: Guideline: infrastructure general 50%, SC/ST/women 60%; fish-farmer inputs 50%; women activities 60%; insurance premium 90%; training 100%, on approved norms. Small RAS/biofloc norm ₹4.5 lakh: individual up to two units at separate sites in stages, group up to four. Solar unit approved actual cost capped ₹15 lakh; hill holding ≥500 sq m or plains ≥1 ha, one unit. Trout input unit ₹90,000 for growers with ≥2 years experience. Matsya Saheli women processing DPR unit norm ₹10 lakh.
schemes.eligible: Approved fish farmers and eligible groups/women; component-specific area, experience and project criteria.
schemes.access: District fisheries officer; component DPR, land/water/site documents, technical estimate and bank details; pre-sanction inspection. Insurance requires pre-stocking notification, input/seed bills and geotag records. Approval and annual budget govern release.
schemes.caution: This is one programme with components. Approved cost norms are not guaranteed cash receipts; annual sanction/current intake unconfirmed. No duplicate central/state insurance assistance.
schemes.locator: Checked 2026-10-02; Appendix A pp.1–8, infrastructure/input/women/insurance rates and components.
